text: Correct. It's up to the athlete or the coach what they're going to be testing, but ideally, throughout their programming, they're going to be focused on some things. Maybe at the beginning, they could say, "What do you want to test at the end of this block? Is there any specific number you want to test at the end of this block? Your strength, your cardio, your speed?" and then they can check those boxes at the beginning so that, at the end of the block, it tells them, "All right, it's time for your test. Get ready. This test is going to be this day. Just make sure you understand that and all of that." And if they don't need to test anything, then they don't have to pick that also. "No need for testing" is fine too.
